title: Top 2% List Validity: code and data (v1.0.0)
description: Code (MIT licence), derived data and record-linkage audit trail (CC BY-NC 4.0) for a preregistered criterion-validity study of the Stanford–Elsevier top 2% list in health sciences research. The data adapt the Stanford–Elsevier database (CC BY-NC 3.0), so the archive as a whole is CC BY-NC 4.0. See README.md and DATA_LICENSE.md.
